caseName: Shenandoah Valley Broadcasting, Inc. v. American Society of Composers, Authors & Publishers
caseNameFull: SHENANDOAH VALLEY BROADCASTING, INC., Et Al. v. AMERICAN SOCIETY OF COMPOSERS, AUTHORS & PUBLISHERS
attorneys: Ralstone R. Irvine and Walter R. Mansfield for appellants., Arthur H. Dean, William Piel, Jr., Herman Finkelstein and Lloyd N. Cutler for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
